content.value_statement: Teams need dependable pipelines, data models, and DataOps checks for production analytics. This skill guides architecture, orchestration, quality validation, performance tuning, and governance decisions.
actual_capabilities: Explains scalable batch, streaming, and hybrid data pipeline patterns.
Guides ETL and ELT workflow design with orchestration, quality checks, and monitoring.
Summarizes data modeling patterns for reliability, maintainability, and performance.
Provides DataOps practices for testing, deployment, observability, and incident response.
Covers tool choices across Python, SQL, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, and cloud data platforms.
Includes simple local CLI script templates for pipeline, quality, and optimization workflows.
limitations: The included scripts are starter templates and do not implement full production processing.
It does not connect directly to warehouses, orchestration services, or cloud accounts.
Deployment commands require environment review and explicit operator approval.
Compliance guidance is general and does not replace legal or security review.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Analytics Pipeline
use_cases.description: Design ingestion, transformation, validation, orchestration, and monitoring steps before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Review Data Model Tradeoffs
use_cases.description: Compare modeling patterns for scale, query performance, maintainability, and governance requirements.

use_cases.title: Standardize DataOps Practices
use_cases.description: Create shared practices for testing, deployment, observability, incident handling, and production readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Pipeline Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the best pipeline architecture options for my dataset, latency needs, data volume, and team skills.

prompt_templates.title: Design an ELT Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an ELT workflow for these sources, transformations, quality checks, orchestration needs, and warehouse constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Data Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this data model for reliability, performance, governance, lineage, and downstream analytics usability.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Production Readiness Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production readiness plan for this data platform, including testing, monitoring, deployment, rollback, and ownership.

output_examples.input: Design a near real-time customer events pipeline.
output_examples.output: A layered architecture with ingestion, stream processing, durable storage, validation checks, orchestration, alerting, and ownership recommendations.

output_examples.input: Review our dbt model for performance and governance.
output_examples.output: A structured review covering model grain, materialization choice, test coverage, lineage, access controls, and cost risks.

output_examples.input: Prepare a DataOps rollout plan for a small team.
output_examples.output: A phased plan for development standards, automated checks, deployment approvals, monitoring dashboards, incident response, and documentation.

best_practices: Provide source systems, data volume, latency goals, ownership boundaries, and compliance constraints before asking for an architecture.
Ask for tradeoffs between batch, streaming, and hybrid designs when requirements are uncertain.
Use generated plans as review material before running deployment or migration commands.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a production pipeline without describing data contracts, failure handling, and monitoring needs.
Do not copy deployment commands into shared environments without approval and rollback planning.
Do not treat starter scripts as complete production implementations.

faq.question: What data platforms does this skill support?
faq.answer: It discusses Python, SQL, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, and cloud data platforms.

faq.question: Can it build a complete production pipeline?
faq.answer: It can create architecture and implementation guidance. The included scripts are starter templates, not full production systems.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. The documented commands are examples and should require explicit user approval before execution.

faq.question: Can it help with data quality?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers validation, testing, monitoring, anomaly detection, and operational checks for data workflows.

faq.question: Is this useful for analytics engineers?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports data model reviews, dbt planning, transformation design, lineage, and governance discussions.

faq.question: Does it replace security or compliance review?
faq.answer: No. It provides general guidance for encryption, access control, privacy, and auditing, but expert review remains necessary.
